title: BJP workers protest in Bhopal against Kharge remarks

tea.why: BJP workers protested against remarks made by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge concerning the Prime Minister's late father.
tea.want: Protesters demanded that Congress leaders cease personal attacks and change their conduct.
tea.changed: Oct 27: Police used water cannons to disperse rival party workers, leading to an injury during the confrontation.

summary: On October 26, 2026, Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leaders and workers gathered near Red Cross Hospital Square in Bhopal and marched towards the Congress office to register a strong protest against Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge. The demonstrators burned an effigy and chanted slogans condemning Kharge, Rahul Gandhi, and the Congress party over comments directed at the Prime Minister's late father at an event in Patna. Congress workers gathered outside their party office, leading to a tense face-off between the rival groups. Police officers deployed barricades and utilized a water cannon to manage the crowds and separate the parties. According to Additional DCP Shailendra Singh Chauhan, some members of the opposing party crossed the barricades and were removed from the spot.
demands: Stop using objectionable language and personal attacks
Respect elderly and revered public figures
response: Police deployed barricades, managed the crowds, and used water cannons to disperse rival party workers who came face to face near the Congress office.
